Social Pretexting via Phone, target Other: the false kidnapping report (swatting-style hoax to emergency services) caused employees to evacuate; the people deceived were police/emergency services, so target Other and asset P - Other. Reviewer may drop the social action if it is judged not to be part of the breaching chain.

Victim unnamed (wider reporting suggests a retirement/trust custodian); NAICS 523940 assumed (portfolio management/investment advice); reviewer may adjust. Headcount Unknown. dbir_year 2023.

event_chain.summary: Client's stolen identity used to access servers
False kidnapping report gets employees evacuated

summary: In February 2022 Evan Frederick Light of Indiana and co-conspirators used the stolen identity of a client of an investment holdings company in Sioux Falls, South Dakota to access the company's servers, exfiltrated personal information of hundreds of clients, and used it to steal more than $37 million in cryptocurrency from 571 clients. Court testimony says the conspirators used a false kidnapping report to get employees evacuated during the intrusion. Light was sentenced in February 2025 to 20 years in prison.

victim.victim_id: Unnamed investment holdings company (Sioux Falls, SD)
